S01E01.title: The One Where Monica Gets a Roommate

words.original: This is not even a date.
words.scene: 莫妮卡说和保罗出去吃饭不算是约会，大家在中央公园咖啡馆里调侃她。
words.example: Are you going on a date with him tonight?
words.originalZh: 这甚至不是一次约会。
words.exampleZh: 今晚你要和他约会吗？

words.original: I realize I am totally naked.
words.scene: 钱德勒讲述自己做了一个在食堂里全身赤裸的怪梦。
words.example: I walked into the wrong changing room and felt completely naked.
words.originalZh: 我意识到我完全赤身裸体。
words.exampleZh: 我走进了错误的更衣室，感觉自己完全赤身裸体。

words.original: Finally, I figure I'd better answer it.
words.scene: 钱德勒在梦中听到电话响，最后决定接起来。
words.example: I figure we should leave before the rain starts.
words.originalZh: 最后，我想我最好回答一下。
words.exampleZh: 我想我们应该在下雨之前离开。

words.original: It turns out it's my mother, which is very-very weird because she never calls me!
words.scene: 钱德勒在梦中接电话，发现是妈妈打来的，觉得很奇怪。
words.example: It's weird that he didn't show up for work today.
words.originalZh: 原来是我妈妈，这非常非常奇怪，因为她从来不给我打电话！
words.exampleZh: 奇怪的是他今天没有来上班。

words.original: Carol moved her stuff out today.
words.scene: 罗斯难过地告诉大家，前妻卡罗尔今天把东西都搬走了。
words.example: I need to pack all my stuff before moving.
words.originalZh: 卡罗尔今天把她的东西搬出去了。
words.exampleZh: 搬家之前我需要收拾好所有东西。

words.original: Okay, everybody relax.
words.scene: 大家围着罗斯开玩笑，莫妮卡让大家放松一点。
words.example: Take a deep breath and try to relax.
words.originalZh: 好吧，大家放松一下。
words.exampleZh: 深呼吸并尝试放松。

words.original: And you never knew she was a lesbian...
words.scene: 菲比直接点出罗斯离婚的原因，大家讨论卡罗尔是女同性恋。
words.example: She came out as a lesbian in college.
words.originalZh: 你永远不知道她是女同性恋......
words.exampleZh: 她在大学时就公开承认自己是女同性恋。

words.original: I don't want to be single, okay?
words.scene: 罗斯哭诉自己不想单身，只想再次结婚。
words.example: He's been single for two years now.
words.originalZh: 我不想单身，好吗？
words.exampleZh: 现在他已经单身两年了。

words.original: This really gorgeous Limoges gravy boat.
words.scene: 瑞秋回忆婚礼前看到一只精美的调味汁瓶，突然觉醒自己不爱巴瑞。
words.example: You look gorgeous in that dress.
words.originalZh: 这艘非常华丽的利摩日肉汁船。
words.exampleZh: 你穿那件衣服看起来很漂亮。

words.original: And then I got really freaked out.
words.scene: 瑞秋意识到自己竟然对调味汁瓶比对未婚夫更有感觉，吓坏了。
words.example: Don't freak out, but I think I lost your keys.
words.originalZh: 然后我真的吓坏了。
words.exampleZh: 别惊慌，但我想我丢了你的钥匙。

words.original: It's a metaphor, Daddy!
words.scene: 瑞秋对父亲解释自己不想只做一只鞋子，这是人生比喻。
words.example: The phrase 'time is money' is a common metaphor.
words.originalZh: 这是一个比喻，爸爸！
words.exampleZh: “时间就是金钱”这句话是一个常见的比喻。

words.original: You and I have kinda drifted apart, but you're the only person I knew who lived here in the city.
words.scene: 瑞秋逃到莫妮卡家，解释虽然两人疏远了，但莫妮卡是她唯一认识的人。
words.example: We used to be close, but we slowly drifted apart.
words.originalZh: 你和我已经有点疏远了，但你是我认识的唯一一个住在这个城市的人。
words.exampleZh: 我们曾经很亲近，但慢慢疏远了。

words.original: I was kinda hoping that wouldn't be an issue...
words.scene: 瑞秋说莫妮卡没被邀请参加婚礼，希望这不会成为问题。
words.example: Money is a sensitive issue in many relationships.
words.originalZh: 我有点希望这不会成为问题......
words.exampleZh: 金钱是许多关系中的敏感问题。

words.original: I was in the room where we were keeping all the presents.
words.scene: 瑞秋回忆婚礼前在放礼品的房间里看调味汁瓶。
words.example: I bought a present for my mom's birthday.
words.originalZh: 我当时在我们存放所有礼物的房间里。
words.exampleZh: 我给妈妈买了一份生日礼物。

words.original: So you wanna tell us now or are we waiting for four wet bridesmaids?
words.scene: 钱德勒调侃瑞秋，问她要不要等四位湿漉漉的伴娘来了再说。
words.example: She asked her sister to be her bridesmaid.
words.originalZh: 所以你想现在告诉我们还是我们在等待四个湿漉漉的伴娘？
words.exampleZh: 她请姐姐做她的伴娘。

words.original: I was looking at this gravy boat.
words.scene: 瑞秋看着一只调味汁瓶出神，意识到自己对婚姻的不满。
words.example: Please pass me the gravy for the mashed potatoes.
words.originalZh: 我正在看这个肉汁船。
words.exampleZh: 请把土豆泥的肉汁递给我。

words.original: Independence. Taking control of your life.
words.scene: 莫妮卡鼓励瑞秋独立，掌控自己的人生。
words.example: She moved out to become more independent.
words.originalZh: 独立。掌控你的生活。
words.exampleZh: 她搬出去是为了变得更加独立。

words.original: Joey and Chandler are coming over to help me put together my new furniture.
words.scene: 莫妮卡让瑞秋一起来组装新家具，乔伊和钱德勒会来帮忙。
words.example: We bought some new furniture for the living room.
words.originalZh: 乔伊和钱德勒要过来帮我组装新家具。
words.exampleZh: 我们为客厅买了一些新家具。

words.original: We got a bookcase.
words.scene: 乔伊和钱德勒帮莫妮卡组装家具，以为装好了一个书架。
words.example: I need a bigger bookcase for all my novels.
words.originalZh: 我们有一个书柜。
words.exampleZh: 我需要一个更大的书柜来存放我所有的小说。

words.original: I would have to say that is an 'L'-shaped bracket.
words.scene: 乔伊和钱德勒搞不懂剩下的零件，猜测是L形支架。
words.example: The shelf needs a metal bracket to support it.
words.originalZh: 我不得不说这是一个“L”形支架。
words.exampleZh: 架子需要一个金属支架来支撑。

words.original: You got screwed.
words.scene: 大家发现卡罗尔带走了家具和电器，罗斯什么也没得到，钱德勒说他被坑了。
words.example: I got screwed by that car dealership.
words.originalZh: 你被搞砸了。
words.exampleZh: 我被那家汽车经销商搞砸了。

words.original: I'm such an idiot.
words.scene: 罗斯自责没发现卡罗尔每周看四五次牙医的真正原因。
words.example: I felt like an idiot for forgetting her name.
words.originalZh: 我真是个白痴。
words.exampleZh: 我因为忘记了她的名字而感觉自己像个白痴。

words.original: I shredded my old boyfriend's favorite bath towel.
words.scene: 菲比讲自己失恋后干过最坏的事，把前男友最喜欢的浴巾撕烂。
words.example: Could you hand me a clean towel?
words.originalZh: 我撕碎了我前男友最喜欢的浴巾。
words.exampleZh: 你能给我一条干净的毛巾吗？

words.original: I'm divorced. I'm only 26, and I'm divorced!
words.scene: 罗斯在咖啡馆里沮丧地宣布自己离婚了。
words.example: Their divorce was finalized last month.
words.originalZh: 我离过婚。我才26岁，就离婚了！
words.exampleZh: 他们的离婚于上个月完成。

words.original: That's like saying there's only one flavor of ice cream for you.
words.scene: 乔伊安慰罗斯，说世界上还有很多女人，就像冰淇淋有很多口味。
words.example: What's your favorite flavor of ice cream?
words.originalZh: 这就像说只有一种口味的冰淇淋适合你。
words.exampleZh: 你最喜欢什么口味的冰淇淋？

words.original: Stay out of my freezer!
words.scene: 乔伊用冰淇淋比喻女人，罗斯让他离冰箱远点。
words.example: I keep frozen vegetables in the freezer.
words.originalZh: 离我的冰箱远点！
words.exampleZh: 我把冷冻蔬菜放在冰箱里。

words.original: I haven't been able to, uh, perform.
words.scene: 罗斯向保罗倾诉自从卡罗尔离开后，自己在性生活上无法表现。
words.example: She performed well under pressure.
words.originalZh: 我没能，呃，表演。
words.exampleZh: 她在压力下表现得很好。

words.original: Rach, wait, I can cancel...
words.scene: 莫妮卡想为了陪瑞秋而取消和保罗的约会。
words.example: I had to cancel my dentist appointment.
words.originalZh: 瑞秋，等等，我可以取消……
words.exampleZh: 我不得不取消我的牙医预约。

words.original: I was laughed out of twelve interviews today.
words.scene: 瑞秋找工作失败，说今天十二场面试都被嘲笑出来。
words.example: I have a job interview tomorrow morning.
words.originalZh: 今天我在十二次采访中被笑了。
words.exampleZh: 明天早上我有一个工作面试。

words.original: How'd you pay for them? Uh, credit card.
words.scene: 瑞秋买了打折靴子，大家问她怎么付的，她说是爸爸的信用卡。
words.example: I paid for dinner with my credit card.
words.originalZh: 你是怎么付钱给他们的？嗯，信用卡。
words.exampleZh: 我用信用卡支付了晚餐费用。

expressions.original: C'mon, you're going out with the guy!
expressions.scene: 乔伊一语道破莫妮卡和保罗的关系，说他们在约会。
expressions.example: I heard she's going out with someone from her office.
expressions.originalZh: 来吧，你要和那个家伙出去！
expressions.exampleZh: 我听说她要和她办公室的人出去。

expressions.original: I don't want her to go through what I went through with Carl.
expressions.scene: 乔伊不想让瑞秋经历自己曾经受过的情伤。
expressions.example: She's going through a tough time right now.
expressions.originalZh: 我不想让她经历我和卡尔经历过的事情。
expressions.exampleZh: 她现在正在经历一段艰难的时期。

expressions.original: To hell with her, she left me!
expressions.scene: 罗斯假装大方祝福卡罗尔，随后改口说去她的，是她甩了我。
expressions.example: To hell with the rules, let's have some fun.
expressions.originalZh: 让她见鬼去吧，她离开了我！
expressions.exampleZh: 让规则见鬼去吧，让我们享受一些乐趣。

expressions.original: Why does everyone keep fixating on that?
expressions.scene: 罗斯不想大家一直围绕他是同性恋前妻的话题打转。
expressions.example: Don't fixate on your mistakes; learn from them.
expressions.originalZh: 为什么大家都这么关注这个？
expressions.exampleZh: 不要纠缠于自己的错误；向他们学习。

expressions.original: Ooh, this is a Dear Diary moment.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋兴奋地说莫妮卡终于等到保罗约她，这是值得写日记的时刻。
expressions.example: Getting the job offer was a real Dear Diary moment.
expressions.originalZh: 哦，这是亲爱的日记时刻。
expressions.exampleZh: 获得工作机会是一个真正的亲爱的日记时刻。

expressions.original: Joey and Chandler are coming over to help me put together my new furniture.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡邀请瑞秋来家里，乔伊和钱德勒会帮忙组装新家具。
expressions.example: It took me three hours to put together the desk.
expressions.originalZh: 乔伊和钱德勒要过来帮我组装新家具。
expressions.exampleZh: 我花了三个小时才把桌子组装好。

expressions.original: Listen, while you're on a roll...
expressions.scene: 钱德勒见瑞秋会做咖啡了，调侃她既然状态好就再做个煎蛋卷。
expressions.example: She's on a roll, winning every game this week.
expressions.originalZh: 听着，当你在滚动时......
expressions.exampleZh: 她状态正佳，本周赢得了每一场比赛。

expressions.original: Welcome back to the world! Grab a spoon!
expressions.scene: 乔伊鼓励罗斯重回单身世界，像吃冰淇淋一样去认识不同的人。
expressions.example: The job market is hot—grab a spoon and apply everywhere.
expressions.originalZh: 欢迎回到世界！拿勺子！
expressions.exampleZh: 就业市场火爆——拿起勺子，到处应聘。

expressions.original: You gonna crash on the couch?
expressions.scene: 瑞秋剪掉信用卡后，莫妮卡问她要不要在沙发上睡。
expressions.example: Can I crash on the couch tonight? I'm too tired to go home.
expressions.originalZh: 你会瘫倒在沙发上吗？
expressions.exampleZh: 今晚我可以在沙发上睡觉吗？我太累了，不想回家了。

expressions.original: Back in high school, I had a, um, major crush on you.
expressions.scene: 罗斯向瑞秋坦白高中时曾暗恋她。
expressions.example: He had a major crush on her since freshman year.
expressions.originalZh: 回到高中时，我非常，嗯，非常迷恋你。
expressions.exampleZh: 从大一开始，他就迷恋上了她。

S01E02.title: The One with the Sonogram at the End

words.original: For us, kissing is as important as any part of it.
words.scene: 瑞秋向男生们解释，对女生来说接吻非常重要。
words.example: They shared their first kiss under the stars.
words.originalZh: 对我们来说，接吻和接吻的任何部分一样重要。
words.exampleZh: 他们在星空下分享了他们的初吻。

words.original: Everything you need to know is in that first kiss. Absolutely.
words.scene: 莫妮卡赞同瑞秋，说初吻能说明一切。
words.example: Are you coming to the party? Absolutely!
words.originalZh: 你需要知道的一切都在初吻中。绝对地。
words.exampleZh: 你来参加聚会吗？绝对地！

words.original: I mean it's like the stand-up comedian you have to sit through before Pink Floyd comes out.
words.scene: 钱德勒把接吻比作演唱会前的暖场喜剧演员。
words.example: The comedian made everyone laugh at the club.
words.originalZh: 我的意思是，这就像单口喜剧演员在平克·弗洛伊德（Pink Floyd）出来之前你必须耐心看完。
words.exampleZh: 这位喜剧演员让俱乐部里的每个人都开怀大笑。

words.original: Well, she has issues.
words.scene: 大家在博物馆里看到罗斯的前妻，乔伊说她有问题。
words.example: He has some anger issues he needs to work on.
words.originalZh: 嗯，她有问题。
words.exampleZh: 他有一些愤怒问题需要解决。

words.original: I'm pregnant.
words.scene: 卡罗尔在博物馆里告诉罗斯她怀孕了。
words.example: She found out she was pregnant last week.
words.originalZh: 我怀孕了。
words.exampleZh: 她上周发现自己怀孕了。

words.original: Speaking of issues, isn't that your ex-wife?
words.scene: 菲比在博物馆里看到罗斯的前妻卡罗尔，提醒罗斯。
words.example: He remains friends with his ex-wife.
words.originalZh: 说起来，那不是你的前妻吗？
words.exampleZh: 他和前妻仍然是朋友。

words.original: Marty's still totally paranoid.
words.scene: 卡罗尔和罗斯寒暄时提到家人玛蒂仍然很多疑。
words.example: Stop being paranoid; no one is following you.
words.originalZh: 马蒂仍然很偏执。
words.exampleZh: 别再偏执了；没有人跟随你。

words.original: I think this is the episode of Three's Company where there's some kind of misunderstanding.
words.scene: 钱德勒用电视剧里的误会情节来调侃罗斯的处境。
words.example: It was all a misunderstanding, and we're fine now.
words.originalZh: 我认为这是《三人行》中存在某种误会的一集。
words.exampleZh: 一切都是误会，现在我们都好了。

words.original: I just don't wanna give them any more ammunition than they already have.
words.scene: 莫妮卡紧张地准备迎接父母，不想给他们更多挑剔的把柄。
words.example: Don't give your enemies ammunition to attack you.
words.originalZh: 我只是不想给他们更多的弹药。
words.exampleZh: 不要给敌人攻击你的弹药。

words.original: You're like all chaotic and twirly.
words.scene: 瑞秋觉得莫妮卡因为父母要来而慌慌张张。
words.example: The kitchen was chaotic during dinner rush.
words.originalZh: 你就像一切混乱而扭曲。
words.exampleZh: 晚餐高峰期间厨房很混乱。

words.original: Yeah, calm down.
words.scene: 大家劝莫妮卡冷静，不要过于紧张父母的到访。
words.example: Calm down, it's not the end of the world.
words.originalZh: 是的，冷静点。
words.exampleZh: 冷静点，这不是世界末日。

words.original: Has anybody seen my engagement ring?
words.scene: 瑞秋找不到要还给巴瑞的订婚戒指，非常慌张。
words.example: He proposed with a beautiful engagement ring.
words.originalZh: 有人看到我的订婚戒指了吗？
words.exampleZh: 他用一枚漂亮的订婚戒指求婚。

words.original: You got a beautiful lasagna here that looks good enough to avoid touching.
words.scene: 钱德勒调侃莫妮卡做的千层面虽然好看，但不许别人碰。
words.example: My grandmother makes the best lasagna.
words.originalZh: 这里有一份漂亮的烤宽面条，看起来很好，让人不敢碰。
words.exampleZh: 我祖母做的烤宽面条是最好吃的。

words.original: Oh, like I wasn't dreading tomorrow enough, having to give it back to him...
words.scene: 瑞秋本来就害怕明天还戒指给巴瑞，现在戒指还不见了。
words.example: I dread going to the dentist.
words.originalZh: 哦，好像我还不够害怕明天，不得不把它还给他......
words.exampleZh: 我害怕去看牙医。

words.original: I'm the girl in the veil who stomped on your heart in front of your entire family!
words.scene: 瑞秋想象自己还戒指时如何自嘲，说自己践踏了巴瑞的心。
words.example: The angry customer stomped out of the store.
words.originalZh: 我就是当着你全家的面踩你心的那个蒙面女孩！
words.exampleZh: 愤怒的顾客跺着脚走出了商店。

words.original: Kinda puts that whole pillow thing in perspective, huh, Mon?
words.scene: 罗斯告诉大家卡罗尔怀孕了，让大家觉得枕头的事根本不算什么。
words.example: Losing my job put things in perspective for me.
words.originalZh: 有点透视整个枕头的事情，是吗，Mon？
words.exampleZh: 失去工作让我对事情有了更清晰的认识。

words.original: Carol says she and Susan want me to be involved.
words.scene: 卡罗尔希望罗斯也参与孩子的生活，但决定权在他。
words.example: He wants to be more involved in his children's education.
words.originalZh: 卡罗尔说她和苏珊希望我参与其中。
words.exampleZh: 他希望更多地参与孩子的教育。

words.original: I mean presumably, the biggest part of your job is done.
words.scene: 钱德勒调侃罗斯，说他在怀孕这件事上最大的贡献已经完成了。
words.example: Presumably, she'll arrive around noon.
words.originalZh: 我的意思是，你的工作大部分已经完成了。
words.exampleZh: 估计她会在中午左右到达。

words.original: And the most enjoyable.
words.scene: 乔伊接着钱德勒的调侃，说那也是最有意思的部分。
words.example: The trip was very enjoyable despite the rain.
words.originalZh: 而且是最享受的。
words.exampleZh: 尽管下着雨，这次旅行还是很愉快的。

words.original: They want me to go down to this sonogram thing with them tomorrow.
words.scene: 卡罗尔和苏珊邀请罗斯一起去做超声波检查。
words.example: We saw the baby on the sonogram for the first time.
words.originalZh: 他们希望我明天和他们一起去做超声波检查。
words.exampleZh: 我们第一次在超声检查上看到婴儿。

words.original: No news, no little anecdotes to share with the folks?
words.scene: 罗斯爸爸问罗斯有没有什么新闻或趣事和父母分享。
words.example: He told a funny anecdote about his first day at work.
words.originalZh: 没有新闻，没有小轶事与人们分享？
words.exampleZh: 他讲述了他第一天上班的趣闻。

words.original: These people are pros.
words.scene: 钱德勒形容莫妮卡的父母是专业级别的挑剔高手。
words.example: Leave it to the pros; they'll handle it.
words.originalZh: 这些人都是专业人士。
words.exampleZh: 把它留给专业人士；他们会处理的。

words.original: Identical? Yeah, people say we look alike.
words.scene: 钱德勒提到自己和双胞胎姐姐，大家说她们长得很像。
words.example: The two dresses are identical except for the color.
words.originalZh: 完全相同的？是啊，人们都说我们长得很像。
words.exampleZh: 这两件衣服除了颜色之外一模一样。

words.original: I did have an imaginary friend, who my parents actually preferred.
words.scene: 钱德勒自嘲小时候有个假想朋友，父母甚至更喜欢那个朋友。
words.example: Children often have imaginary friends.
words.originalZh: 我确实有一个想象中的朋友，我的父母实际上更喜欢他。
words.exampleZh: 孩子们常常有想象中的朋友。

words.original: As someone who's recently been dumped?
words.scene: 瑞秋问罗斯还戒指的建议，罗斯说自己刚被甩。
words.example: She dumped him after three months of dating.
words.originalZh: 作为一个最近被抛弃的人？
words.exampleZh: 约会三个月后，她抛弃了他。

words.original: You should try not to look too terrific, I know it'll be hard.
words.scene: 罗斯建议瑞秋还戒指时不要打扮得太好，以免刺激巴瑞。
words.example: You did a terrific job on the presentation.
words.originalZh: 你应该尽量不要看起来太了不起，我知道这会很困难。
words.exampleZh: 你的演讲做得非常出色。

words.original: Yes, and she's very supportive.
words.scene: 苏珊告诉罗斯，医生了解她们的特殊情况并且很支持。
words.example: My family has always been supportive of my decisions.
words.originalZh: 是的，而且她非常支持。
words.exampleZh: 我的家人一直支持我的决定。

words.original: Why are you so tanned?
words.scene: 瑞秋见到巴瑞时发现他晒得很黑，原来他去了阿鲁巴。
words.example: She came back from the beach looking tanned.
words.originalZh: 你为什么晒得这么黑？
words.exampleZh: 她从海滩回来，看上去晒黑了。

words.original: And I'm an orthodontist.
words.scene: 巴瑞说自己是牙医，言下之意是他本可以伤害瑞秋但忍住了。
words.example: My orthodontist recommended braces for my teeth.
words.originalZh: 我是一名正牙医生。
words.exampleZh: 我的正牙医生建议我戴上牙套。

words.original: Knock knock! How are we today? Any nausea?
words.scene: 医生来给卡罗尔做检查，问她有没有恶心的感觉。
words.example: The medication can cause nausea in some patients.
words.originalZh: 敲敲门！我们今天怎么样？有恶心吗？
words.exampleZh: 该药物可能会导致某些患者恶心。

expressions.original: For us, kissing is as important as any part of it.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋向男生们解释，接吻对女生来说和亲密关系其他部分一样重要。
expressions.example: Exercise is as important as a healthy diet.
expressions.originalZh: 对我们来说，接吻和接吻的任何部分一样重要。
expressions.exampleZh: 锻炼和健康饮食一样重要。

expressions.original: Yeah, well, word of advice: Bring back the comedian.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋建议男生们要多接吻，就像让暖场喜剧演员返场一样。
expressions.example: Let me give you a word of advice: always save your work.
expressions.originalZh: 是的，好吧，我的建议是：把喜剧演员带回来。
expressions.exampleZh: 让我给你一个建议：永远保存你的工作。

expressions.original: How about I'll catch up with you in the Ice Age?
expressions.scene: 罗斯不想和朋友一起面对卡罗尔，说冰河世纪再碰面吧。
expressions.example: I'll catch up with you later for coffee.
expressions.originalZh: 我在冰河世纪里追上你怎么样？
expressions.exampleZh: 我稍后会来找你喝咖啡。

expressions.original: Are you through with that?
expressions.scene: 罗斯想拿走卡罗尔喝完的饮料杯，问她是否喝完了。
expressions.example: Are you through with the newspaper? I'd like to read it.
expressions.originalZh: 你说完了吗？
expressions.exampleZh: 你看完报纸了吗？我想读一下。

expressions.original: Having to give it back to him...
expressions.scene: 瑞秋发愁明天要把订婚戒指还给巴瑞。
expressions.example: Please give it back when you're done reading.
expressions.originalZh: 还得还给他...
expressions.exampleZh: 阅读完毕后请归还。

expressions.original: Because I think it might take some of the heat off me.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡希望罗斯说出卡罗尔怀孕的事，让父母不再盯着自己挑剔。
expressions.example: His apology took some of the heat off the company.
expressions.originalZh: 因为我认为这可能会减轻我的一些热情。
expressions.exampleZh: 他的道歉平息了公司的一些热度。

expressions.original: We ran into her parents at the club, they were not playing very well.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡妈妈提到在俱乐部偶遇瑞秋父母，他们对婚礼的事很不高兴。
expressions.example: I ran into an old classmate at the supermarket.
expressions.originalZh: 我们在俱乐部遇到了她的父母，他们踢得不太好。
expressions.exampleZh: 我在超市遇到了一位老同学。

expressions.original: People like Ross who need to shoot for the stars, with his museum, and his papers getting published.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡爸爸夸奖罗斯有远大抱负，在博物馆工作并发表学术论文。
expressions.example: Don't be afraid to shoot for the stars in your career.
expressions.originalZh: 像罗斯这样的人需要为明星而努力，他的博物馆和他的论文都要出版。
expressions.exampleZh: 不要害怕为职业生涯中的明星而奋斗。

expressions.original: Things change, roll with the punches.
expressions.scene: 苏珊劝罗斯接受现实，生活总会变化，要学会应对。
expressions.example: Life is unpredictable, so learn to roll with the punches.
expressions.originalZh: 世事变迁，顺势而为。
expressions.exampleZh: 人生无常，所以要学会随遇而安。

expressions.original: Well, he's a big boy, he'll get over it.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋担心和艾伦分手会伤害他，莫妮卡说他是个大人会走出来的。
expressions.example: I know you're upset, but you'll get over it soon.
expressions.originalZh: 好吧，他是个大孩子了，他会克服的。
expressions.exampleZh: 我知道你很难过，但你很快就会克服的。

words.original: He walked me to the subway and said 'We should do this again!''
words.scene: 菲比告诉大家约会对象送她到地铁站，说了句客套话。
words.example: I take the subway to work every morning.
words.originalZh: 他送我到地铁并说“我们应该再做一次！”
words.exampleZh: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。

words.original: Loosely translated 'We should do this again' means 'You will never see me naked'.'
words.scene: 菲比解释约会用语，说'改天再约'其实是不会再见了。
words.example: This is a loosely based adaptation of the novel.
words.originalZh: 粗略地翻译“我们应该再做一次”意味着“你永远不会看到我裸体”。
words.exampleZh: 这是对小说的松散改编。

words.original: I'm gonna be dating leather-wearing alcoholics and complaining about them to you.
words.scene: 菲比解释'你人很好'的潜台词，暗示会去找别人约会。
words.example: He realized he was becoming an alcoholic and sought help.
words.originalZh: 我要和穿着皮衣的酒鬼约会并向你抱怨他们。
words.exampleZh: 他意识到自己正在酗酒并寻求帮助。

words.original: Cushions the blow.
words.scene: 菲比说这些委婉语是为了缓和拒绝带来的打击。
words.example: A soft chair will cushion your fall.
words.originalZh: 缓冲打击。
words.exampleZh: 柔软的椅子可以缓冲你的跌倒。

words.original: Cushions the blow.
words.scene: 菲比解释约会时说好听话是为了让对方更容易接受被拒绝的打击。
words.example: Losing the game was a big blow to the team.
words.originalZh: 缓冲打击。
words.exampleZh: 输掉比赛对于球队来说是一个很大的打击。

words.original: They had this unbelievable farm, and horses, and rabbits that he could chase.
words.scene: 罗斯回忆小时候家里的狗被送到农场，可以追兔子的美好画面。
words.example: The kids love to chase each other in the yard.
words.originalZh: 他们有这个令人难以置信的农场，还有他可以追赶的马和兔子。
words.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在院子里互相追逐。

words.original: That's ridiculous!
words.scene: 乔伊听说可以用拇指尖到食指尖的距离判断某个尺寸，觉得很荒谬。
words.example: That's a ridiculous idea; it will never work.
words.originalZh: 太荒谬了！
words.exampleZh: 这是一个可笑的想法；它永远不会起作用。

words.original: Decaf cappuccino for Joey.
words.scene: 瑞秋当服务员越来越熟练，准确说出大家的咖啡订单。
words.example: I'll have a decaf latte, please.
words.originalZh: 给乔伊的无咖啡因卡布奇诺。
words.exampleZh: 请给我一杯无咖啡因拿铁咖啡。

words.original: I'm going through my mail, and I open up their monthly, you know, STATEMENT.
words.scene: 菲比查看银行每月寄来的账单，发现账户多了五百美元。
words.example: I check my bank statement every month.
words.originalZh: 我正在查看邮件，然后打开他们的每月声明。
words.exampleZh: 我每个月都会检查我的银行对账单。

words.original: There's five hundred extra dollars in my account.
words.scene: 菲比发现银行账户里莫名其妙多了五百美元。
words.example: I opened a savings account at the bank.
words.originalZh: 我的账户里还有五百美元。
words.exampleZh: 我在银行开了一个储蓄账户。

words.original: It's not mine, I didn't earn it.
words.scene: 菲比认为多出来的钱不是她赚的，所以不能要。
words.example: She earns a good salary as a software engineer.
words.originalZh: 这不是我的，不是我赚来的。
words.exampleZh: 作为一名软件工程师，她的薪水很高。

words.original: It would be like this giant karmic debt.
words.scene: 菲比说如果把不属于自己的钱花掉，会欠下巨大的因果债。
words.example: He worked hard to pay off his student debt.
words.originalZh: 就像这个巨大的业债一样。
words.exampleZh: 他努力工作来偿还学生债务。

words.original: Think about what you went through the last time you quit.
words.scene: 大家劝钱德勒想想上次戒烟有多痛苦，不要重新开始抽烟。
words.example: He decided to quit smoking for his health.
words.originalZh: 想想你上次戒烟时经历了什么。
words.exampleZh: 为了健康，他决定戒烟。

words.original: You've been so good, for three years! And this is my reward!
words.scene: 钱德勒重新开始抽烟，自嘲这是自己三年不抽烟的'奖励'。
words.example: Getting a bonus was a nice reward for all my hard work.
words.originalZh: 三年了，你过得真好！这就是我的奖励！
words.exampleZh: 获得奖金是对我所有辛勤工作的良好奖励。

words.original: Just give me a chance to figure that out.
words.scene: 莫妮卡说还需要时间想清楚自己对艾伦的感觉。
words.example: I need to figure out how to fix this computer.
words.originalZh: 请给我一个机会来解决这个问题。
words.exampleZh: 我需要弄清楚如何修理这台电脑。

words.original: They're like coyotes, picking off the weak members of the herd.
words.scene: 莫妮卡形容朋友们看到她带男人回家就会像土狼一样扑上去。
words.example: Coyotes are often heard howling at night in the desert.
words.originalZh: 他们就像土狼一样，捕杀牛群中的弱者。
words.exampleZh: 夜间在沙漠中经常能听到郊狼的嚎叫声。

words.original: Picking off the weak members of the herd.
words.scene: 莫妮卡比喻朋友们专挑她带回家的男生中的'弱者'围攻。
words.example: A herd of cows was grazing in the field.
words.originalZh: 剔除牛群中的弱者。
words.exampleZh: 一群牛正在田野里吃草。

words.original: Well, you do realise that the odds of that happening are a little slimmer.
words.scene: 钱德勒指出如果不让朋友见艾伦，他们喜欢他的几率就更小了。
words.example: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
words.originalZh: 嗯，你确实意识到这种情况发生的可能性有点小。
words.exampleZh: 中彩票的几率非常低。

words.original: The odds of that happening are a little slimmer.
words.scene: 钱德勒说如果朋友们见不到艾伦，他们喜欢上他的可能性就更渺茫。
words.example: His chances of getting the job are slim.
words.originalZh: 发生这种情况的可能性要小一些。
words.exampleZh: 他获得这份工作的机会很小。

words.original: Can't I whimper a little bit?
words.scene: 莫妮卡被大家说服，但还是想小声哭一下。
words.example: The puppy began to whimper when left alone.
words.originalZh: 我就不能呜咽一下吗？
words.exampleZh: 当小狗独自一人时，它开始呜咽。

words.original: The way his smile was kinda crooked.
words.scene: 大家夸艾伦笑起来有点歪，非常迷人。
words.example: The picture on the wall is a little crooked.
words.originalZh: 他的笑容有点扭曲。
words.exampleZh: 墙上的画有点歪。

words.original: From the nursery rhyme.
words.scene: 钱德勒提到一首童谣里有个歪歪的男人，来形容艾伦的笑容。
words.example: She sang a nursery rhyme to her baby.
words.originalZh: 出自童谣。
words.exampleZh: 她给她的宝宝唱了一首童谣。

words.original: I think Alan will become the yardstick against which all future boyfriends will be measured.
words.scene: 菲比说艾伦会成为以后衡量莫妮卡所有男友的标准。
words.example: Good customer service should be the yardstick for every business.
words.originalZh: 我认为艾伦将成为衡量所有未来男友的标尺。
words.exampleZh: 良好的客户服务应该成为每个企业的衡量标准。

words.original: We sure showed those Hassidic jewellers a thing or two about softball.
words.scene: 大家和艾伦一起打垒球并赢了比赛，非常兴奋。
words.example: Our company has a softball team that plays every Thursday.
words.originalZh: 我们确实向那些哈西德珠宝商展示了一两件关于垒球的事情。
words.exampleZh: 我们公司有一支垒球队，每周四进行比赛。

words.original: Yeah, it's his, uh, innate Alan-ness that we adore.
words.scene: 大家调侃莫妮卡，说她们喜欢的是艾伦天生的艾伦气质。
words.example: She has an innate talent for music.
words.originalZh: 是的，我们崇拜的是他，呃，与生俱来的艾伦气质。
words.exampleZh: 她有着与生俱来的音乐天赋。

words.original: It's his innate Alan-ness that we adore.
words.scene: 朋友们都非常喜欢艾伦，夸他内在的特质。
words.example: I adore the way she laughs.
words.originalZh: 我们欣赏的是他与生俱来的艾伦气质。
words.exampleZh: 我很喜欢她笑起来的样子。

words.original: Did you pick out the vowels?
words.scene: 菲比给街头女孩莉琪带字母汤，问她是否挑出了元音字母。
words.example: A, E, I, O, U are the vowels in English.
words.originalZh: 你挑出元音了吗？
words.exampleZh: A、E、I、O、U 是英语中的元音。

words.original: Sure you don't wanna pretzel?
words.scene: 莉琪问菲比要不要买个椒盐卷饼。
words.example: I bought a soft pretzel at the mall.
words.originalZh: 你确定不想吃椒盐卷饼吗？
words.exampleZh: 我在商场买了一个软椒盐卷饼。

words.original: So I have a flaw! Big deal?
words.scene: 钱德勒因为抽烟被大家批评，辩解说每个人都有缺点。
words.example: Perfectionism can be both a strength and a flaw.
words.originalZh: 所以我有一个缺点！有什么大不了的？
words.exampleZh: 完美主义既可以是优点，也可以是缺点。

words.original: Even nicer when everyone gets to wear their underwear.
words.scene: 莫妮卡感慨大家聚在一起真好，钱德勒调侃要是都穿着内衣就更好了。
words.example: Don't forget to pack clean underwear for the trip.
words.originalZh: 当每个人都穿上内衣时就更好了。
words.exampleZh: 不要忘记为旅途携带干净的内衣。

expressions.original: He walked me to the subway and said 'We should do this again!''
expressions.scene: 菲比说约会对象送她到地铁站时说'改天再约'，其实是不会再见了。
expressions.example: The dinner was fun; we should do this again sometime.
expressions.originalZh: 他送我到地铁并说“我们应该再做一次！”
expressions.exampleZh: 晚餐很有趣；我们应该找个时间再这样做一次。

expressions.meaning: 不是你的问题（分手借口）
expressions.original: Like 'It's not you' means 'It is you'.'
expressions.scene: 菲比解释约会暗语，说'不是你的问题'其实意思就是'就是你'。
expressions.example: When he said 'It's not you, it's me,' I knew he was lying.
expressions.originalZh: 就像“这不是你”意味着“是你”。
expressions.exampleZh: 当他说“不是你，是我”时，我知道他在撒谎。

expressions.original: Cushions the blow.
expressions.scene: 菲比解释人们说委婉话是为了让对方更容易接受坏消息。
expressions.example: He offered me a small bonus to cushion the blow of the pay cut.
expressions.originalZh: 缓冲打击。
expressions.exampleZh: 他给了我一笔小额奖金，以缓解减薪带来的影响。

expressions.original: Put it out!
expressions.scene: 钱德勒又开始抽烟，大家让他把烟熄灭。
expressions.example: Please put out your cigarette before entering the building.
expressions.originalZh: 放出来吧！
expressions.exampleZh: 进入大楼前请熄灭香烟。

expressions.original: Keep the change.
expressions.scene: 菲比请莉琪喝汽水，剩下的零钱给她当小费。
expressions.example: Here's ten dollars; keep the change.
expressions.originalZh: 留着零钱吧。
expressions.exampleZh: 这是十美元；留着零钱吧。

expressions.original: I bring a guy home, and within five minutes they're all over him.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡抱怨每次带男人回家，朋友们五分钟内就会围上去。
expressions.example: The fans were all over the celebrity as soon as he arrived.
expressions.originalZh: 我带一个人回家，五分钟之内他们就对他了如指掌。
expressions.exampleZh: 这位名人一到就受到了粉丝们的关注。

expressions.original: Joey, let it go.
expressions.scene: 乔伊缠着莫妮卡想见艾伦，莫妮卡让他别再提了。
expressions.example: I know you're angry, but you need to let it go.
expressions.originalZh: 乔伊，放手吧。
expressions.exampleZh: 我知道你很生气，但你需要放下它。

expressions.original: I've decided to break up with Alan.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡终于告诉朋友们她决定和艾伦分手。
expressions.example: She broke up with her boyfriend last weekend.
expressions.originalZh: 我决定和艾伦分手。
expressions.exampleZh: 上周末她和男友分手了。

expressions.original: Well, he's a big boy, he'll get over it.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡担心艾伦难过，钱德勒说他是个大人会走出来的。
expressions.example: It took him months to get over the breakup.
expressions.originalZh: 好吧，他是个大孩子了，他会克服的。
expressions.exampleZh: 他花了几个月的时间才从分手的阴影中走出来。

expressions.original: I should really get back to work.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋说该回去继续当服务员工作了，钱德勒调侃说她会让客人拿到真正点的东西。
expressions.example: Lunch is over; let's get back to work.
expressions.originalZh: 我真的应该回去工作了。
expressions.exampleZh: 午餐结束了；让我们回去工作吧。

S01E04.title: The One with George Stephanopoulos
S01E04.zh_title: 乔治·史蒂法诺普洛斯之夜

words.original: If I were omnipotent for a day, I would want world peace, no more hunger...
words.scene: 大家在咖啡馆讨论如果变得全能会许什么愿望。
words.example: In the story, the wizard was omnipotent and could do anything.
words.originalZh: 如果我有一天无所不能，我希望世界和平，不再有饥饿......
words.exampleZh: 故事中，巫师无所不能，无所不能。

words.original: Would you look at her? She is so peaceful.
words.scene: 瑞秋在沙发上睡着，莫妮卡说她看起来很安详。
words.example: The lake was so peaceful in the early morning.
words.originalZh: 你会看她一眼吗？她是那么的平静。
words.exampleZh: 清晨的湖水是那么的平静。

words.original: It's okay, you just nodded off again.
words.scene: 瑞秋在咖啡馆里不停打瞌睡，朋友们安慰她。
words.example: I nodded off during the boring lecture.
words.originalZh: 没关系，你又打瞌睡了。
words.exampleZh: 无聊的讲座中我打瞌睡了。

words.original: My grandmother has a new boyfriend, and they're both kind of insecure in bed.
words.scene: 菲比解释自己为什么睡不着，因为奶奶和新男友都很没自信。
words.example: He feels insecure about speaking in public.
words.originalZh: 我祖母有了一个新男朋友，他们在床上都缺乏安全感。
words.exampleZh: 他对在公共场合讲话感到不安全。

words.original: So they're constantly having to reassure each other that they're having a good time.
words.scene: 菲比说奶奶和男友不断互相确认对方是否开心。
words.example: She called to reassure me that everything was fine.
words.originalZh: 因此，他们必须不断地向对方保证他们玩得很开心。
words.exampleZh: 她打电话让我放心，一切都很好。

words.original: Look, my first paycheck! Look at the window, there's my name!
words.scene: 瑞秋兴奋地展示自己人生中第一份薪水支票。
words.example: I can't wait to get my paycheck this Friday.
words.originalZh: 看，我的第一份薪水！看窗外，有我的名字！
words.exampleZh: 我等不及要在这个星期五拿到我的薪水了。

words.original: I wiped tables for it, I steamed milk for it, and it was totally not worth it.
words.scene: 瑞秋抱怨自己擦桌子、热牛奶赚来的工资根本不值得。
words.example: Please wipe the counter after you make dinner.
words.originalZh: 我为它擦桌子，为它蒸牛奶，完全不值得。
words.exampleZh: 吃完晚饭后请擦拭柜台。

words.original: Everyone I know is either getting married, or getting pregnant, or getting promoted, and I'm getting coffee!
words.scene: 瑞秋对信用卡客服发泄，说朋友们都在结婚怀孕升职，而她只能端咖啡。
words.example: She was promoted to manager after three years.
words.originalZh: 我认识的每个人要么结婚，要么怀孕，要么升职，而我正在喝咖啡！
words.exampleZh: 三年后，她晋升为经理。

words.original: Look at you in the apron. You look like you're in a play.
words.scene: 瑞秋的朋友来咖啡馆看到她穿着围裙当服务生。
words.example: He put on an apron before he started cooking.
words.originalZh: 看看围裙里的你。你看起来像是在看戏。
words.exampleZh: 开始做饭之前，他系上了围裙。

words.original: Kiki, you look phenomenal. I mean, you've lost like a ton of weight.
words.scene: 瑞秋的朋友琦琦怀孕，另一个朋友夸她状态非凡。
words.example: The band gave a phenomenal performance last night.
words.originalZh: 琪琪，你看起来棒极了。我的意思是，你的体重减轻了很多。
words.exampleZh: 乐队昨晚进行了精彩的表演。

words.original: Guess who my dad's making partner in his firm?
words.scene: 瑞秋的朋友们互相炫耀家里的事业和好消息。
words.example: He became a partner at the law firm this year.
words.originalZh: 猜猜我爸爸让谁成为他公司的合伙人？
words.exampleZh: 今年他成为该律师事务所的合伙人。

words.original: Well, the biggest news is still you dumping Barry at the altar!
words.scene: 朋友们聊起瑞秋在圣坛前抛弃巴瑞的八卦。
words.example: She dumped her boyfriend after he lied to her.
words.originalZh: 好吧，最大的新闻仍然是你把巴里甩在了祭坛上！
words.exampleZh: 在男友对她撒谎后，她抛弃了他。

words.original: Well, the biggest news is still you dumping Barry at the altar!
words.scene: 朋友们聊起瑞秋在婚礼圣坛前逃跑的八卦。
words.example: They exchanged rings at the altar.
words.originalZh: 好吧，最大的新闻仍然是你把巴里甩在了祭坛上！
words.exampleZh: 他们在祭坛上交换了戒指。

words.original: I even do my own laundry.
words.scene: 瑞秋向朋友证明自己独立，说自己甚至自己洗衣服。
words.example: I have to do laundry this weekend.
words.originalZh: 我什至自己洗衣服。
words.exampleZh: 这个周末我必须洗衣服。

words.original: I take the dead flowers out of the vase.
words.scene: 瑞秋列举自己在咖啡馆的工作内容，包括清理花瓶里的枯花。
words.example: She put the fresh flowers in a glass vase.
words.originalZh: 我把死去的花从花瓶里拿出来。
words.exampleZh: 她把鲜花放在玻璃花瓶里。

words.original: We thought since Phoebe was staying over tonight we'd have kinda like a slumber party thing.
words.scene: 莫妮卡提议菲比来借住，大家办一个睡衣派对。
words.example: The girls had a slumber party and stayed up all night talking.
words.originalZh: 我们想既然菲比今晚要过夜，我们就得举办一场睡衣派对。
words.exampleZh: 女孩们举办了一场睡衣派对，彻夜不眠地聊天。

words.original: We got some trashy magazines, we got cookie dough, we got Twister...
words.scene: 莫妮卡准备睡衣派对的东西，包括八卦杂志和饼干面团。
words.example: She loves reading trashy magazines at the beach.
words.originalZh: 我们有一些垃圾杂志，我们有饼干面团，我们有Twister......
words.exampleZh: 她喜欢在海滩上阅读垃圾杂志。

words.original: We got some trashy magazines, we got cookie dough, we got Twister...
words.scene: 莫妮卡列举睡衣派对的食物，包括曲奇饼干面团。
words.example: I made pizza dough from scratch last night.
words.originalZh: 我们有一些垃圾杂志，我们有饼干面团，我们有Twister......
words.exampleZh: 昨晚我从头开始做了披萨面团。

words.original: I brought Operation! But I lost the tweezers, so we can't operate.
words.scene: 菲比带了桌游 Operation，但镊子丢了没法做手术。
words.example: I need tweezers to pull out this splinter.
words.originalZh: 我带来了行动！但我把镊子丢了，所以我们无法进行手术。
words.exampleZh: 我需要镊子来拔出这个碎片。

words.original: They say there's been some unusual activity on your account.
words.scene: 信用卡公司打电话来说瑞秋的账户有异常活动。
words.example: I need to check my bank account balance.
words.originalZh: 他们说您的帐户出现了一些异常活动。
words.exampleZh: 我需要检查我的银行账户余额。

words.original: Oh, bonehead, bonehead! When you do that, you're only hitting yourself.
words.scene: 披萨小弟送错披萨后捶自己头，乔伊说他是笨蛋。
words.example: Don't be such a bonehead—read the instructions first.
words.originalZh: 噢，笨蛋，笨蛋！当你这样做时，你只是在打击自己。
words.exampleZh: 别那么傻——先阅读说明。

words.original: Was he wearing a stunning blue suit and a power tie?
words.scene: 瑞秋幻想乔治·史蒂法诺普洛斯穿着帅气的蓝西装。
words.example: You look stunning in that dress.
words.originalZh: 他穿着漂亮的蓝色西装和强力领带吗？
words.exampleZh: 你穿那件衣服看起来很漂亮。

words.original: White House adviser? Clinton's campaign guy?
words.scene: 大家讨论街对面住的是克林顿的竞选顾问。
words.example: He works as a financial adviser for the company.
words.originalZh: 白宫顾问？克林顿的竞选人？
words.exampleZh: 他担任该公司的财务顾问。

words.original: The one with the great hair, sexy smile, really cute butt?
words.scene: 菲比和瑞秋描述乔治·史蒂法诺普洛斯迷人的外貌。
words.example: He fell and hurt his butt on the ice.
words.originalZh: 那个有着一头漂亮的头发、性感的微笑、非常可爱的屁股的人吗？
words.exampleZh: 他在冰上摔倒了，屁股受伤了。

words.meaning: 预科生风格的，名牌高校的
words.original: I think you have to draw him out. And then when you do, he's a preppy animal.
words.scene: 女孩们幻想乔治·史蒂法诺普洛斯的真实性格。
words.example: He dresses in a classic preppy style with polo shirts.
words.originalZh: 我认为你必须把他拉出来。当你这样做的时候，他就是一只预科生。
words.exampleZh: 他穿着经典的学院派风格的马球衫。

words.original: One time, he helped me put on my coat, and he was really tender.
words.scene: 莫妮卡回忆乔伊帮她穿外套时很温柔。
words.example: He gave her a tender look before leaving.
words.originalZh: 有一次，他帮我穿上外套，真的很温柔。
words.exampleZh: 离开前，他温柔地看了她一眼。

words.original: I have a feeling that Chandler is a lot more sophisticated than he seems.
words.scene: 女孩们讨论钱德勒其实比看起来更有深度。
words.example: She has very sophisticated taste in wine and art.
words.originalZh: 我有一种感觉，钱德勒比他看上去的要老练得多。
words.exampleZh: 她对葡萄酒和艺术有着非常高雅的品味。

words.original: Where's my puck?
words.scene: 罗斯在冰球比赛后发现自己拿到的冰球不见了。
words.example: The player shot the puck into the goal.
words.originalZh: 我的冰球在哪里？
words.exampleZh: 该球员将冰球射入球门。

words.original: The guy's a freak. I judge him.
words.scene: 乔伊得知罗斯只和一个女人上过床后觉得他是怪胎。
words.example: Some people call him a freak because he dresses differently.
words.originalZh: 这家伙是个怪胎。我评判他。
words.exampleZh: 有些人称他为怪胎，因为他的穿着与众不同。

words.original: Could've played Monopoly, but nooooo.
words.scene: 大家在玩扭扭乐，罗斯抱怨本来可以玩大富翁。
words.example: We spent the whole afternoon playing Monopoly.
words.originalZh: 本来可以玩大富翁，但是不行。
words.exampleZh: 我们花了整个下午玩大富翁。

expressions.original: See, there's always one guy.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒说如果自己能全能一天，就会让自己永远全能，乔伊吐槽总有这种人。
expressions.example: Every group project has that one person who does nothing—there's always one guy.
expressions.originalZh: 你看，总有一个人。
expressions.exampleZh: 每个团队项目都有一个无所事事的人——总有一个人。

expressions.meaning: 你说什么？/请再说一遍？（表示惊讶或不满）
expressions.original: Probably kill myself! ..Excuse me?
expressions.scene: 乔伊误以为 omnipotent 是别的意思，说要自杀，罗斯惊讶地问“什么？”。
expressions.example: Excuse me? I can't believe you just said that.
expressions.originalZh: 大概是自杀吧！ ..打扰一下？
expressions.exampleZh: 打扰一下？我不敢相信你刚才这么说。

expressions.meaning: 你怎么了？/你最近怎么回事？
expressions.original: What's going on with you? I got no sleep last night!
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡看到瑞秋状态不好，问她怎么了。
expressions.example: You look tired. What's going on with you?
expressions.originalZh: 你怎么了？我昨晚一夜没睡！
expressions.exampleZh: 你看起来很累。你怎么了？

expressions.original: You know what, I'd better pass on the game.
expressions.scene: 罗斯因为想起和卡罗尔的纪念日，决定不去看冰球赛。
expressions.example: I'll pass on dessert tonight, I'm too full.
expressions.originalZh: 你知道吗，我最好放弃这个游戏。
expressions.exampleZh: 今晚我要吃甜点了，我太饱了。

expressions.original: The hell with hockey, let's all do that!
expressions.scene: 钱德勒讽刺地说去他的冰球，大家一起去想前妻吧。
expressions.example: The hell with waiting in line—let's go home.
expressions.originalZh: 曲棍球见鬼去吧，让我们都这么做吧！
expressions.exampleZh: 去他妈的排队吧——我们回家吧。

expressions.original: Alright, maybe it'll take my mind off it.
expressions.scene: 罗斯同意去看冰球，希望比赛能让他暂时忘记卡罗尔。
expressions.example: Going for a run helps take my mind off stress.
expressions.originalZh: 好吧，也许这会让我不再去想它。
expressions.exampleZh: 跑步可以帮助我摆脱压力。

expressions.original: Do you promise to buy me a big thumb finger? You got it.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒答应罗斯会给他买个大手指道具。
expressions.example: Can you help me move this box? You got it.
expressions.originalZh: 你答应给我买一个大拇指吗？你明白了。
expressions.exampleZh: 你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？你明白了。

expressions.original: I wiped tables for it, I steamed milk for it, and it was totally not worth it.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋拿到第一份工资后觉得辛苦工作根本不值得。
expressions.example: The argument got so heated that it just wasn't worth it.
expressions.originalZh: 我为它擦桌子，为它蒸牛奶，完全不值得。
expressions.exampleZh: 争论变得如此激烈，以至于不值得。

expressions.original: All things considered, you had fun tonight.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒劝罗斯承认，综合来说今晚他还是玩得开心。
expressions.example: All things considered, the party went really well.
expressions.originalZh: 总而言之，你今晚玩得很开心。
expressions.exampleZh: 考虑到所有因素，聚会进行得非常顺利。

expressions.meaning: 谁先找到归谁，后到没得。
expressions.original: Finders keepers, losers weepers.
expressions.scene: 小孩捡到罗斯的冰球不肯还，说先到先得。
expressions.example: I found this dollar on the ground—finders keepers, losers weepers.
expressions.originalZh: 胜利者守门，失败者哭泣。
expressions.exampleZh: 我在地上发现了这块钱——发现者守着，失败者哭泣。

S01E05.title: The One with the East German Laundry Detergent

words.original: You just reach in there, there's one little maneuver, and bam, a bra right out the sleeve.
words.scene: 菲比展示她能把胸罩从袖子里抽出来的神奇动作。
words.example: The driver made a quick maneuver to avoid the bicycle.
words.originalZh: 你只要把手伸进去，做一个小动作，然后砰的一声，胸罩就从袖子里出来了。
words.exampleZh: 司机迅速采取行动避开了自行车。

words.original: There's the horrible awkward moment when you've handed her the note.
words.scene: 钱德勒形容分手时把纸条递给对方的尴尬时刻。
words.example: There was an awkward silence after his joke fell flat.
words.originalZh: 当你把纸条递给她时，有一个可怕的尴尬时刻。
words.exampleZh: 他的笑话落空后，现场陷入了尴尬的沉默。

words.original: I think she'd feel like we're gangin' up on her.
words.scene: 钱德勒担心如果大家一起去和珍妮斯分手，她会感觉被围攻。
words.example: The older kids ganged up on him and took his lunch money.
words.originalZh: 我想她会觉得我们在联合起来对付她。
words.exampleZh: 大一点的孩子们联合起来攻击他，抢走了他的午饭钱。

words.original: You're breaking up with Tony? Yeah, I know, he's sweet, but it's just not fun anymore.
words.scene: 莫妮卡提到自己和托尼分手，瑞秋惊讶。
words.example: She dumped him after three months of dating.
words.originalZh: 你要和托尼分手吗？是的，我知道，他很可爱，但这不再有趣了。
words.exampleZh: 约会三个月后，她抛弃了他。

words.original: I don't know if it's me, or his hunger strike, or I don't know.
words.scene: 莫妮卡说和托尼分手可能是因为他的绝食抗议。
words.example: The prisoners went on a hunger strike to demand better conditions.
words.originalZh: 我不知道是我的原因，还是他绝食的原因，还是我不知道。
words.exampleZh: 囚犯们绝食抗议，要求改善条件。

words.original: Last week you had a wonderful, nutty, chocolatey kind of a cakey pie thing.
words.scene: 顾客在咖啡馆里向瑞秋形容上周吃的坚果巧克力派。
words.example: This cookie has a rich, nutty flavor.
words.originalZh: 上周你吃了一个美妙的、坚果味的、巧克力味的蛋糕派。
words.exampleZh: 这种饼干具有浓郁的坚果味。

words.original: It's my father. He wants to give me a Mercedes convertible.
words.scene: 瑞秋说爸爸想用奔驰敞篷车诱惑她搬回家。
words.example: He drove down the coast in a red convertible.
words.originalZh: 这是我的父亲。他想送我一辆梅赛德斯敞篷车。
words.exampleZh: 他开着一辆红色敞篷车沿着海岸行驶。

words.original: Actually, I got the extended disco version, with three choruses of 'You'll never make it on your own'.
words.scene: 瑞秋形容爸爸又对她长篇大论地说她无法独立生活。
words.example: The movie has an extended version with extra scenes.
words.originalZh: 事实上，我得到了扩展的迪斯科版本，其中有三段副歌“你永远不会自己成功”。
words.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个加长版，有额外的场景。

words.original: Actually, I got the extended disco version, with three choruses of 'You'll never make it on your own'.
words.scene: 瑞秋用“副歌重复三遍”来形容爸爸的唠叨。
words.example: Everyone sang along to the chorus of the song.
words.originalZh: 事实上，我得到了扩展的迪斯科版本，其中有三段副歌“你永远不会自己成功”。
words.exampleZh: 大家跟着这首歌的副歌一起唱。

words.original: Wow, being dumped by you obviously agrees with her.
words.scene: 乔伊看到前女友安吉拉变得更漂亮，说被乔伊甩掉显然对她很好。
words.example: This warm weather really agrees with me.
words.originalZh: 哇，被你甩了，显然她很同意。
words.exampleZh: 这温暖的天气真的很适合我。

words.original: I don't wanna seem too eager.
words.scene: 乔伊想去和前女友打招呼，但又不想显得太急切。
words.example: The students were eager to hear the exam results.
words.originalZh: 我不想显得太急切。
words.exampleZh: 学生们迫不及待地想知道考试结果。

words.original: That's because I'm wearing a dress that accents my boobs.
words.scene: 安吉拉说自己的裙子很显胸。
words.example: The red scarf accents the color of her eyes.
words.originalZh: 那是因为我穿的裙子凸显了我的胸部。
words.exampleZh: 红色围巾凸显了她眼睛的颜色。

words.original: Oh, big glamour night. Me and Monica at Laundorama.
words.scene: 瑞秋讽刺地说今晚很精彩，要和莫妮卡去洗衣店。
words.example: The actress brought old Hollywood glamour to the event.
words.originalZh: 哦，盛大的魅力之夜。我和莫妮卡在自助洗衣店。
words.exampleZh: 这位女演员为这次活动带来了古老的好莱坞魅力。

words.original: You wanna hear a freaky coincidence? Guess who's doing laundry there too?
words.scene: 罗斯假装巧合也要去同一家洗衣店，制造和瑞秋独处的机会。
words.example: What a coincidence! I was just thinking about you.
words.originalZh: 你想听一个奇怪的巧合吗？猜猜谁也在那里洗衣服？
words.exampleZh: 真是巧合啊！我只是在想你。

words.original: They're attracted to the dryer sheets, and they're goin' in fine, but they're comin' out all fluffy.
words.scene: 罗斯编造借口说公寓洗衣房的老鼠被烘干机纸吸引，出来变得毛茸茸。
words.example: The kitten was small, white, and fluffy.
words.originalZh: 它们被烘干纸所吸引，进去时一切顺利，但出来时却毛茸茸的。
words.exampleZh: 这只小猫很小，白色，毛茸茸的。

words.original: Bob is great. He's smart, he's sophisticated, and he has a real job.
words.scene: 安吉拉夸新男友鲍勃聪明成熟又有正经工作。
words.example: She prefers sophisticated novels to simple love stories.
words.originalZh: 鲍勃很棒。他很聪明，他很老练，而且他有一份真正的工作。
words.exampleZh: 比起简单的爱情故事，她更喜欢复杂的小说。

words.original: You go on three auditions a month and you call yourself an actor?
words.scene: 安吉拉讽刺乔伊一个月只试镜三次还自称演员。
words.example: He has an audition for a movie role next week.
words.originalZh: 你一个月试镜三次就称自己为演员？
words.exampleZh: 下周他要参加一个电影角色的试镜。

words.original: Not after your cousin who could belch the alphabet.
words.scene: 莫妮卡拒绝乔伊安排的相亲，说上次他表哥会打嗝念字母。
words.example: He drank too much soda and started to belch.
words.originalZh: 不是你的表弟，他会打嗝的字母表。
words.exampleZh: 他喝了太多苏打水，开始打嗝。

words.original: Angela's different. She's like one of a kind, like a snowflake.
words.scene: 乔伊形容前女友安吉拉像雪花一样独一无二。
words.example: Every snowflake has a unique shape.
words.originalZh: 安吉拉不一样。她就像一片雪花，独一无二。
words.exampleZh: 每一片雪花都有独特的形状。

words.original: It's laundry. The thinking through is pretty minimal.
words.scene: 罗斯轻描淡写地说去洗衣店不用想太多。
words.example: The damage to the car was minimal.
words.originalZh: 这是洗衣服。思考的次数非常少。
words.exampleZh: 对汽车的损坏很小。

words.original: Well, you may wanna rethink the dirty underwear.
words.scene: 钱德勒提醒罗斯，瑞秋可能会看到他的脏内衣。
words.example: Make sure you pack enough clean underwear for the trip.
words.originalZh: 好吧，你可能想重新考虑脏内衣。
words.exampleZh: 确保为旅行携带足够的干净内衣。

words.original: Oh, and uh, the fabric softener?
words.scene: 钱德勒建议罗斯换种柔顺剂，不要再用Snuggles。
words.example: I always add fabric softener to make my clothes smell fresh.
words.originalZh: 哦，呃，织物柔软剂？
words.exampleZh: 我总是添加织物柔软剂以使我的衣服闻起来清新。

words.original: What, it says I'm a sensitive, warm kinda guy, you know, like a warm, fuzzy bear.
words.scene: 罗斯解释自己的Snuggles柔顺剂代表他敏感温暖。
words.example: He's very sensitive to other people's feelings.
words.originalZh: 什么，它说我是一个敏感、温暖的人，你知道，就像一只温暖、毛茸茸的熊。
words.exampleZh: 他对别人的感受非常敏感。

words.original: Oh yeah, that hug looked pretty brutal.
words.scene: 钱德勒和珍妮斯分手后，朋友们讽刺说那个拥抱看起来很绝情。
words.example: The winter wind was brutal this morning.
words.originalZh: 哦，是的，那个拥抱看起来很残酷。
words.exampleZh: 今天早上冬天的风很猛烈。

words.original: No suds, no save.
words.scene: 洗衣店里一个女人抢了瑞秋的洗衣机，说没有泡沫就不算占位。
words.example: The dishwater was full of suds.
words.originalZh: 没有泡沫，就没有保存。
words.exampleZh: 洗碗水中充满了泡沫。

words.original: Oh, hey, uh you must need detergent.
words.scene: 罗斯借给瑞秋自己带的德国洗衣粉。
words.example: I need to buy laundry detergent this weekend.
words.originalZh: 哦，嘿，呃你一定需要清洁剂。
words.exampleZh: 这个周末我需要买洗衣液。

words.original: Oh God. Oh, am I being like a total laundry spaz?
words.scene: 瑞秋第一次洗衣服，自嘲是不是像个洗衣白痴。
words.example: I felt like a total spaz trying to dance at the party.
words.originalZh: 天哪。哦，我是不是像个洗衣狂？
words.exampleZh: 我感觉自己像个疯子，想在聚会上跳舞。

words.original: A third for your delicates, and that would be your bras and your under-panty things.
words.scene: 罗斯教瑞秋把贴身精细衣物分开洗。
words.example: This blouse is made of delicate silk.
words.originalZh: 第三个是你的精致物品，那就是你的胸罩和内裤。
words.exampleZh: 这件衬衫是用精致的丝绸制成的。

words.original: Oh God, I'm gonna look like a big marshmallow peep.
words.scene: 瑞秋把白衣服洗成粉红色，觉得自己像棉花糖。
words.example: We roasted marshmallows over the campfire.
words.originalZh: 天哪，我会看起来像一个大棉花糖。
words.exampleZh: 我们在篝火上烤棉花糖。

words.original: He needed some time to grieve.
words.scene: 钱德勒终于和珍妮斯分手后，需要时间疗伤。
words.example: She took a week off work to grieve for her grandmother.
words.originalZh: 他需要一些时间来悲伤。
words.exampleZh: 她请了一周假来哀悼祖母。

expressions.text: It's not that big a deal.
expressions.original: Would you let it go? It's not that big a deal.
expressions.scene: 罗斯为一件小事纠结，瑞秋让他别太在意。
expressions.example: I know you're upset, but it's not that big a deal.
expressions.originalZh: 你愿意放手吗？这没什么大不了的。
expressions.exampleZh: 我知道你很不高兴，但这没什么大不了的。

expressions.meaning: 让我震惊，让我难以置信
expressions.original: You know what blows my mind? Women can see breasts any time they want.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒感叹女人随时能看到自己的胸，这让他难以置信。
expressions.example: The view from the top of the mountain blew my mind.
expressions.originalZh: 你知道是什么让我心碎吗？女性可以随时看到乳房。
expressions.exampleZh: 山顶的景色让我大吃一惊。

expressions.original: How you get any work done is beyond me.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒说女人随时能看到胸，真不懂她们怎么还能工作。
expressions.example: Why he quit his great job is beyond me.
expressions.originalZh: 如何完成工作超出了我的范围。
expressions.exampleZh: 我不明白他为什么辞去他的伟大工作。

expressions.original: You finally get up the courage to do it, and there's the horrible awkward moment.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒形容分手前要鼓起勇气面对尴尬。
expressions.example: I finally got up the courage to ask her out.
expressions.originalZh: 你终于鼓起勇气去做这件事，然后就出现了可怕的尴尬时刻。
expressions.exampleZh: 我终于鼓起勇气约她出去。

expressions.original: Be a man, just stop calling.
expressions.scene: 罗斯建议钱德勒像个男人一样，直接不再打电话来分手。
expressions.example: Be a man and tell her the truth instead of hiding.
expressions.originalZh: 做个男人，别再打电话了。
expressions.exampleZh: 做个男人，告诉她真相，而不是隐瞒。

expressions.original: Joey, for all we know this guy could be horribly attractive.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡提醒乔伊，鲍勃说不定其实非常迷人。
expressions.example: For all we know, he might already be married.
expressions.originalZh: 乔伊，据我们所知，这个家伙可能非常有吸引力。
expressions.exampleZh: 据我们所知，他可能已经结婚了。

expressions.meaning: 快刀斩乱麻，快速解决痛苦的事
expressions.original: It's just like pulling off a Band-aid. Just do it really fast, and then the wound is exposed.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡比喻分手就像快速撕掉绷带，越快越好。
expressions.example: Ending the relationship was hard, but I pulled it off like a Band-aid.
expressions.originalZh: 这就像撕掉创可贴一样。动作要快，然后伤口就会暴露出来。
expressions.exampleZh: 结束这段关系很困难，但我像创可贴一样成功了。

expressions.original: Well, you'll have to wait your turn.
expressions.scene: 急诊室里护士让罗斯排队等候。
expressions.example: Don't push—everyone has to wait their turn.
expressions.originalZh: 好吧，你得等轮到你了。
expressions.exampleZh: 不要催促——每个人都必须等待轮到他们。

expressions.original: Now come on, get outta my way.
expressions.scene: 洗衣店里抢推车的女人对瑞秋大喊让开。
expressions.example: Get out of my way or I'll be late for the meeting.
expressions.originalZh: 现在来吧，别挡我的路。
expressions.exampleZh: 别挡我的路，不然我开会就要迟到了。

expressions.original: I'm free! I'm free! That oughta do it.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒分手后大喊自由，乔伊说这样他应该没事了。
expressions.example: Just add a little salt and that oughta do it.
expressions.originalZh: 我自由了！我自由了！就应该这样做。
expressions.exampleZh: 只要加一点盐就可以了。

words.meaning: 即将发生的，迫在眉睫的
words.original: Notice, no fear, no sense of impending doom...
words.scene: 乔伊提醒大家，没看过他演戏的人通常不会有末日将至的恐惧感。
words.example: The dark clouds gave a sense of impending rain.
words.originalZh: 注意，没有恐惧，没有厄运即将来临的感觉……
words.exampleZh: 乌云密布，给人一种即将下雨的感觉。

words.original: The exclamation point in the title scares me.
words.scene: 罗斯说戏剧标题里的感叹号让他害怕。
words.example: She added an exclamation point to show her excitement.
words.originalZh: 标题里的感叹号吓到我了。
words.exampleZh: 她加了一个感叹号以表达她的兴奋。

words.original: God. I feel violated.
words.scene: 看完乔伊演的奇怪音乐剧后，罗斯觉得自己被冒犯了。
words.example: I felt violated when someone read my private messages.
words.originalZh: 上帝。我感觉受到了侵犯。
words.exampleZh: 当有人读我的私人信息时，我感到受到了侵犯。

words.original: Did anybody else feel they just wanted to peel the skin off their body?
words.scene: 罗斯形容看乔伊演戏时尴尬到想剥掉自己的皮。
words.example: Peel the banana before you eat it.
words.originalZh: 还有其他人觉得他们只是想剥掉身上的皮吗？
words.exampleZh: 吃之前先把香蕉剥皮。

words.original: Could she be more out of my league?
words.scene: 钱德勒看到剧院里的美女，觉得自己高攀不起。
words.example: She's way out of my league—I doubt she'd go out with me.
words.originalZh: 她能比我更格格不入吗？
words.exampleZh: 她与我格格不入——我怀疑她会和我约会。

words.original: Ross, back me up here. He could never get a woman like that in a million years.
words.scene: 钱德勒想让罗斯帮腔，证明自己配不上那位美女。
words.example: Can you back me up when I tell Mom what happened?
words.originalZh: 罗斯，支持我。一百万年内他都找不到这样的女人。
words.exampleZh: 当我告诉妈妈发生了什么事时，你能支持我吗？

words.original: I'm very very aware of my tongue...
words.scene: 钱德勒紧张地准备上前搭讪，突然非常在意自己的舌头。
words.example: Are you aware that you've been talking for an hour?
words.originalZh: 我非常非常了解我的舌头...
words.exampleZh: 你知道你已经讲了一个小时了吗？

words.original: Stand back, everyone. Incoming ego shrapnel.
words.scene: 钱德勒去搭讪美女，罗斯让大家退后，说自尊碎片要来了。
words.example: The explosion left shrapnel embedded in the wall.
words.originalZh: 大家退后一点。自我弹片即将到来。
words.exampleZh: 爆炸留下的弹片嵌在墙上。

words.original: C'mon, you guys, it wasn't that bad. I was the lead.
words.scene: 乔伊为自己辩护，说自己在戏里是主角。
words.example: He plays the lead in the new movie.
words.originalZh: 来吧，伙计们，事情并没有那么糟糕。我是带头的。
words.exampleZh: 他在这部新电影中担任主角。

words.original: It was better than that thing I did with the trolls, at least you got to see my head.
words.scene: 乔伊比较自己以前演巨魔只露出头的经历。
words.example: The children's book was full of trolls living under bridges.
words.originalZh: 这比我对付巨魔的那件事要好，至少你能看到我的头。
words.exampleZh: 这本儿童读物充满了住在桥下的巨魔。

words.original: She pronounces my name 'Chand-lrr'. 'Chand-lrr'.
words.scene: 钱德勒说奥萝拉把他的名字念成“钱德勒尔”。
words.example: Can you pronounce this French word for me?
words.originalZh: 她念出我的名字“Chand-lrr”。 “Chand-lrr”。
words.exampleZh: 你能为我发音这个法语单词吗？

words.original: Oh, listen, the usher gave me this to give to you.
words.scene: 剧院引座员给了乔伊一张经纪公司的名片。
words.example: The usher showed us to our seats.
words.originalZh: 哦，听着，引座员给了我这个给你。
words.exampleZh: 引座员带我们到座位上。

words.original: The Estelle Leonard Talent Agency. Wow, an agency left me its card!
words.scene: 乔伊发现一家经纪公司给他留了名片，非常兴奋。
words.example: She signed with a modeling agency last month.
words.originalZh: 埃斯特尔·伦纳德人才经纪公司。哇，一家机构给我留下了名片！
words.exampleZh: 她上个月与一家模特经纪公司签约。

words.original: You weren't expecting someone so fantastically beautiful.
words.scene: 乔伊见到经纪人埃斯特尔时，她自恋地夸自己美丽。
words.example: The party was fantastically fun.
words.originalZh: 你没想到会有一个如此美丽的人。
words.exampleZh: 聚会非常有趣。

words.original: No, I wanna go to the top of the Empire State Building and make out.
words.scene: 经纪人埃斯特尔用《西雅图夜未眠》的梗开玩笑说要和乔伊亲热。
words.example: They were making out in the back seat of the car.
words.originalZh: 不，我想去帝国大厦的顶层亲热。
words.exampleZh: 他们在车后座亲热。

words.original: It was unbelievable. I've never met anyone like her.
words.scene: 钱德勒形容和奥萝拉的约会太不可思议了。
words.example: The view from the mountain was unbelievable.
words.originalZh: 这太令人难以置信了。我从未见过像她这样的人。
words.exampleZh: 山上的景色令人难以置信。

words.original: Oh, I'm sorry, then you're widowed? Hopefully?
words.scene: 钱德勒得知奥萝拉有丈夫后，希望她不是寡妇。
words.example: She was widowed at a young age.
words.originalZh: 噢，抱歉，那么你是寡妇了吗？希望吗？
words.exampleZh: 她年轻时就丧偶了。

words.original: Sliding your foot so far up my pant leg you can count the change in my pocket?
words.scene: 奥萝拉调情时把脚滑到钱德勒的裤腿上。
words.example: Be careful not to slide on the icy sidewalk.
words.originalZh: 你把脚滑到我裤腿上这么远，你能数出我口袋里的零钱吗？
words.exampleZh: 小心不要在结冰的人行道上滑倒。

words.original: This is twisted! How could you get involved with a woman like this?
words.scene: 朋友们得知奥萝拉同时有丈夫和男友后觉得关系太扭曲。
words.example: That's a twisted way to think about friendship.
words.originalZh: 这太扭曲了！怎么会跟这样的女人扯上关系呢？
words.exampleZh: 这是一种扭曲的思考友谊的方式。

words.original: I mean, this is every guy's fantasy!
words.scene: 钱德勒认为不用负责又能约会的关系是每个男人的幻想。
words.example: Traveling around the world is his ultimate fantasy.
words.originalZh: 我的意思是，这是每个男人的幻想！
words.exampleZh: 环游世界是他的终极幻想。

words.original: Well, y'know, monogamy can be a tricky concept.
words.scene: 罗斯试图从人类学角度解释一夫一妻制很复杂。
words.example: Monogamy is the norm in many cultures.
words.originalZh: 嗯，你知道，一夫一妻制可能是一个棘手的概念。
words.exampleZh: 一夫一妻制是许多文化中的常态。

words.original: I did the windows, I did the floors... I even used all the attachments on the vacuum.
words.scene: 莫妮卡大打扫除，用了吸尘器上的所有配件。
words.example: I need to vacuum the living room before guests arrive.
words.originalZh: 我做了窗户，我做了地板......我什至使用了吸尘器上的所有附件。
words.exampleZh: 我需要在客人到来之前用吸尘器打扫客厅。

words.original: I even used all the attachments on the vacuum, except that little round one with the bristles.
words.scene: 莫妮卡说她不知道吸尘器上带鬃毛的圆头配件是干嘛用的。
words.example: The brush has stiff bristles for scrubbing.
words.originalZh: 我什至使用了真空吸尘器上的所有附件，除了那个带刷毛的小圆形附件。
words.exampleZh: 刷子有硬毛，可以擦洗。

words.original: Oh! I-I see you moved the green ottoman.
words.scene: 莫妮卡发现瑞秋挪动了她的绿色脚凳，非常在意。
words.example: He put his feet up on the ottoman.
words.originalZh: 哦！我-我看到你移动了绿色的脚凳。
words.exampleZh: 他把脚放在脚凳上。

words.original: Okay, so I'm responsible, I'm organised. But hey, I can be a kook.
words.scene: 莫妮卡承认自己有责任感、有条理，但也想证明自己能随性。
words.example: She's very organized and always finishes her work on time.
words.originalZh: 好吧，所以我有责任，我有组织。但是，嘿，我可以成为一个怪人。
words.exampleZh: 她很有条理，总是按时完成工作。

words.original: Okay, so I'm responsible, I'm organised. But hey, I can be a kook.
words.scene: 莫妮卡想证明自己不只是整洁有条理，也可以很随性。
words.example: My neighbor is a bit of a kook, but she's harmless.
words.originalZh: 好吧，所以我有责任，我有组织。但是，嘿，我可以成为一个怪人。
words.exampleZh: 我的邻居有点怪，但她人畜无害。

words.original: Little beads of condensation are inching their way closer and closer to the surface of the wood...
words.scene: 朋友们故意描述冷饮杯上的水珠逼近木桌，刺激莫妮卡。
words.example: Condensation formed on the outside of the cold glass.
words.originalZh: 凝结的小水珠正一点点地靠近木头的表面……
words.exampleZh: 冷玻璃外部形成冷凝。

words.original: Here. I need to borrow some moisturizer.
words.scene: 乔伊要去演阿尔·帕西诺的屁股替身，来借保湿霜。
words.example: I apply moisturizer every morning to keep my skin soft.
words.originalZh: 这里。我需要借一些保湿霜。
words.exampleZh: 我每天早上都会涂保湿霜以保持皮肤柔软。

words.original: No, that was clenching.
words.scene: 导演说乔伊在淋浴戏里屁股夹太紧了。
words.example: He clenched his fists in anger.
words.originalZh: 不，那是握紧的。
words.exampleZh: 他愤怒地握紧了拳头。

words.original: Y'know, I've done nothing but crappy plays for six years.
words.scene: 乔伊因为失去电影机会而沮丧，说自己演了六年烂戏。
words.example: The weather was crappy all weekend.
words.originalZh: 你知道，六年来我除了演蹩脚的戏剧之外什么也没做。
words.exampleZh: 整个周末天气都很糟糕。

expressions.original: Could she be more out of my league?
expressions.scene: 钱德勒看到一位绝色美女，觉得自己完全配不上她。
expressions.example: That job is way out of my league—I don't have enough experience.
expressions.originalZh: 她能比我更格格不入吗？
expressions.exampleZh: 这份工作远远超出了我的能力——我没有足够的经验。

expressions.original: Ross, back me up here.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒想让罗斯帮他证明他追不上那位美女。
expressions.example: Back me up here—wasn't he the one who was late?
expressions.originalZh: 罗斯，支持我。
expressions.exampleZh: 把我扶到这儿来——他不是那个迟到的人吗？

expressions.original: Here goes. Yes? Hi... um... okay, next word would be Chandler!
expressions.scene: 钱德勒鼓起勇气上前和奥萝拉搭讪。
expressions.example: I've never sung in public before, but here goes.
expressions.originalZh: 就这样吧。是的？嗨...嗯...好吧，下一个词是钱德勒！
expressions.exampleZh: 我以前从未在公共场合唱歌，但现在就这样吧。

expressions.original: Take a load off already, darling. Sit already.
expressions.scene: 经纪人埃斯特尔让乔伊坐下来谈。
expressions.example: You look tired—come in and take a load off.
expressions.originalZh: 亲爱的，已经卸下负担了。已经坐下了。
expressions.exampleZh: 你看起来很累——进来减轻一下负担吧。

expressions.original: Once I got on the subway, right, and it was at night, and I rode it all the way to Brooklyn, just for the hell of it.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒对奥萝拉讲自己无聊时坐地铁去布鲁克林的故事。
expressions.example: We drove to the beach at midnight just for the hell of it.
expressions.originalZh: 有一次我坐上了地铁，对吧，那是在晚上，我一路骑到了布鲁克林，只是为了享受它。
expressions.exampleZh: 我们半夜开车去海滩只是为了享受这一切。

expressions.original: It was this perfect evening... more or less.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒形容和奥萝拉的约会大致上很完美。
expressions.example: I've more or less finished the report.
expressions.originalZh: 这是一个完美的夜晚……或多或少。
expressions.exampleZh: 我已经大致完成了报告。

expressions.original: I couldn't do it. Good for you, Joey.
expressions.scene: 乔伊说无法接受和已婚女人约会，莫妮卡夸他做得好。
expressions.example: You got the promotion? Good for you!
expressions.originalZh: 我做不到。对你有好处，乔伊。
expressions.exampleZh: 你升职了吗？对你有好处！

expressions.original: There's a theory, put forth by Richard Leakey...
expressions.scene: 罗斯想引用理查德·里奇的理论来解释一夫一妻制。
expressions.example: He put forth a new plan at the meeting.
expressions.originalZh: 理查德·利基（Richard Leakey）提出了一个理论……
expressions.exampleZh: 他在会上提出了一个新计划。

expressions.original: After all your years of struggling, you've finally been able to crack your way into showbusiness.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒讽刺乔伊经过多年努力终于“打入”演艺圈。
expressions.example: It took years to crack his way into the fashion industry.
expressions.originalZh: 经过多年的奋斗，你终于能够闯入演艺界了。
expressions.exampleZh: 他花了数年时间才进入时尚界。

expressions.original: Look at it this way: you dumped her.
expressions.scene: 罗斯安慰钱德勒，让他换个角度想，其实是他甩了奥萝拉。
expressions.example: Look at it this way—you learned something valuable from the experience.
expressions.originalZh: 这样看：你抛弃了她。
expressions.exampleZh: 这样看——你从这次经历中学到了一些有价值的东西。

words.original: The entire city is blacked out!
words.scene: 全城突然大停电，大家在莫妮卡家惊讶地发现整个城市一片漆黑。
words.example: The storm caused a blackout that lasted six hours.
words.originalZh: 整个城市都漆黑了！
words.exampleZh: 暴风雨造成了持续六个小时的停电。

words.original: Who am I gonna meet in a blackout? Power company guys? Eligible looters?
words.scene: 钱德勒被困在ATM厅，抱怨停电时遇不到合适的单身汉。
words.example: Are you eligible for the employee discount?
words.originalZh: 停电期间我会遇见谁？电力公司的人？合格的抢劫者？
words.exampleZh: 您有资格享受员工折扣吗？

words.original: Who am I gonna meet in a blackout? Power company guys? Eligible looters?
words.scene: 钱德勒被困时自嘲说只能遇到趁火打劫的人。
words.example: Looters broke into stores during the riot.
words.originalZh: 停电期间我会遇见谁？电力公司的人？合格的抢劫者？
words.exampleZh: 骚乱期间，抢劫者闯入商店。

words.original: I am trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre!
words.scene: 钱德勒激动地发现自己和名模吉尔·古达克被困在ATM前厅。
words.example: The vestibule of the building had marble floors.
words.originalZh: 我和吉尔·古达克被困在 ATM 机前厅里！
words.exampleZh: 大楼的前厅铺有大理石地板。

words.original: Is it a vestibule? Maybe it's an atrium.
words.scene: 钱德勒纠结自己和吉尔被困的地方到底叫前厅还是中庭。
words.example: The hotel lobby had a beautiful indoor atrium.
words.originalZh: 是前厅吗？也许这是一个中庭。
words.exampleZh: 酒店大堂有一个漂亮的室内中庭。

words.original: Oh yeah, that is the part to focus on, you idiot!
words.scene: 钱德勒内心责骂自己，居然在纠结是vestibule还是atrium。
words.example: I felt like an idiot when I realized I was wrong.
words.originalZh: 哦，是的，这才是要关注的部分，你这个白痴！
words.exampleZh: 当我意识到自己错了时，我感觉自己像个白痴。

words.original: And officiating at tonight's blackout, is Rabbi Tribbiani.
words.scene: 乔伊戴上犹太小帽，假装拉比主持停电夜。
words.example: The mayor will officiate at the opening ceremony.
words.originalZh: 主持今晚停电的是拉比特里比亚尼。
words.exampleZh: 市长将主持开幕式。

words.original: Well, Chandler's old roommate was Jewish, and these are the only candles we have.
words.scene: 乔伊解释为什么点犹太教的光明节蜡烛。
words.example: She celebrates Jewish holidays with her family.
words.originalZh: 嗯，钱德勒的老室友是犹太人，这些是我们唯一的蜡烛。
words.exampleZh: 她与家人一起庆祝犹太节日。

words.original: Ugly Naked Guy lit a bunch of candles.
words.scene: 大家看到对面丑陋裸男点了很多蜡烛。
words.example: We lit candles during the blackout.
words.originalZh: 丑陋的裸男点燃了一束蜡烛。
words.exampleZh: 停电期间我们点燃了蜡烛。

words.original: The blackout's scaring him.
words.scene: 瑞秋和妈妈说大停电把家里的狗德克斯特吓坏了。
words.example: Don't shout, you'll scare the baby.
words.originalZh: 停电让他害怕。
words.exampleZh: 别喊，会吓到宝宝的。

words.original: I was the last one to know when Chandler got bitten by the peacock at the zoo.
words.scene: 瑞秋举例说自己总是最后知道事情，比如钱德勒被孔雀咬。
words.example: The peacock spread its colorful tail feathers.
words.originalZh: 我是最后一个知道钱德勒在动物园被孔雀咬伤的人。
words.exampleZh: 孔雀展开了五颜六色的尾羽。

words.original: I was the last one to know when you had a crush on Joey when he was moving in.
words.scene: 瑞秋揭发莫妮卡曾经暗恋刚搬来的乔伊。
words.example: She had a crush on her classmate all through high school.
words.originalZh: 当乔伊搬进来时，我是最后一个知道你迷恋他的人。
words.exampleZh: 整个高中时期，她一直暗恋着自己的同学。

words.meaning: 阴森的，令人毛骨悚然的
words.original: Kinda spooky without any lights.
words.scene: 蜡烛燃尽后屋里一片漆黑，菲比说有点恐怖。
words.example: The old abandoned house looked really spooky.
words.originalZh: 没有灯光有点诡异。
words.exampleZh: 废弃的老房子看起来真的很阴森。

words.original: OK, guys, guys? I have the definitive one.
words.scene: 大家在模仿恐龙声音，有人说自己的最逼真。
words.example: This is the definitive guide to Italian cooking.
words.originalZh: 好吧，伙计们，伙计们？我有确定的。
words.exampleZh: 这是意大利烹饪的权威指南。

words.original: Barry wouldn't even kiss me on a miniature golf course.
words.scene: 瑞秋抱怨前男友巴瑞连在迷你高尔夫球场上都不肯亲她。
words.example: The museum has a miniature model of the city.
words.originalZh: 巴里甚至不会在迷你高尔夫球场上亲吻我。
words.exampleZh: 博物馆里有一个城市的微缩模型。

words.original: Passion is way overrated.
words.scene: 罗斯劝瑞秋说激情被高估了，信赖和安全更重要。
words.example: In my opinion, that restaurant is overrated.
words.originalZh: 激情被高估了。
words.exampleZh: 在我看来，那家餐厅被高估了。

words.original: Well, in the case of my ex-wife, lesbianism.
words.scene: 罗斯开玩笑说自己的前妻让他得到了“女同性恋主义”。
words.example: He remains friends with his ex-wife.
words.originalZh: 嗯，就我前妻而言，女同性恋。
words.exampleZh: 他和前妻仍然是朋友。

words.original: Well, in the case of my ex-wife, lesbianism.
words.scene: 罗斯用前妻卡罗尔的例子调侃激情消退后剩下的是什么。
words.example: The novel explores themes of identity and lesbianism.
words.originalZh: 嗯，就我前妻而言，女同性恋。
words.exampleZh: 小说探讨了身份和女同性恋的主题。

words.original: I'm laying the groundwork.
words.scene: 罗斯说自己正在慢慢为追求瑞秋打基础。
words.example: We need to lay the groundwork before starting the project.
words.originalZh: 我正在打基础。
words.exampleZh: 我们需要在项目开始之前打好基础。

words.original: Every day I get just a little bit closer to... Priesthood!
words.scene: 乔伊嘲笑罗斯再不行动就要成神父了。
words.example: He decided to enter the priesthood after college.
words.originalZh: 每一天我都离……圣职更近一点！
words.exampleZh: 大学毕业后，他决定成为一名牧师。

words.original: This is running fingers through your hair. Now this is a tousle.
words.scene: 乔伊教罗斯区分“捋头发”和“弄乱头发”的亲昵程度。
words.example: She tousled his hair affectionately.
words.originalZh: 这是用手指梳理头发。现在这是一个麻烦。
words.exampleZh: 她深情地抚摸着他的头发。

words.original: The wine? The candles? The moonlight?
words.scene: 乔伊提醒罗斯现在气氛正好，有酒、蜡烛和月光。
words.example: We walked along the beach in the moonlight.
words.originalZh: 酒？蜡烛？月光？
words.exampleZh: 我们在月光下沿着海滩散步。

words.original: Um, is it sugarless? Sorry, it's not. Oh, then no thanks.
words.scene: 吉尔请钱德勒吃口香糖，钱德勒先问是否无糖。
words.example: I prefer sugarless gum because it's better for my teeth.
words.originalZh: 嗯，是无糖的吗？抱歉，事实并非如此。哦，那就不用了，谢谢。
words.exampleZh: 我更喜欢无糖口香糖，因为它对我的牙齿更好。

words.original: Gum would be perfection.
words.scene: 钱德勒紧张地改口说口香糖简直是完美选择。
words.example: The dessert was absolute perfection.
words.originalZh: 口香糖就完美了。
words.exampleZh: 甜点绝对是完美的。

words.original: I loathe myself.
words.scene: 钱德勒说完“口香糖是完美选择”后痛恨自己。
words.example: I loathe waking up early on cold mornings.
words.originalZh: 我厌恶自己。
words.exampleZh: 我讨厌在寒冷的早晨早起。

words.original: During a blackout? He'd get trampled!
words.scene: 菲比担心停电时把猫放在走廊会被踩到。
words.example: The crowd almost trampled the small dog.
words.originalZh: 停电期间？他会被践踏的！
words.exampleZh: 人群差点把小狗踩死。

words.original: Mon, wanna go for a ride in my racecar?
words.scene: 乔伊开玩笑邀请莫妮卡坐他的赛车，还炫耀自己的胳膊。
words.example: The racecar sped around the track.
words.originalZh: 周一，想坐我的赛车去兜风吗？
words.exampleZh: 赛车在赛道上飞驰。

words.original: What next? Blow a bubble. A bubble's good. It's got a boyish charm.
words.scene: 钱德勒想通过吹泡泡展现大男孩魅力。
words.example: The kids love to blow soap bubbles in the park.
words.originalZh: 接下来怎么办？吹一个泡泡。有泡沫就好了有一种孩子气的魅力。
words.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里吹肥皂泡。

words.original: Oh my God! And now you're choking.
words.scene: 钱德勒吹泡泡失败，把吉尔给的口香糖吞下去噎到了。
words.example: He started to choke on a piece of bread.
words.originalZh: 我的天啊！现在你窒息了。
words.exampleZh: 他开始被一块面包噎住了。

words.original: I know it's totally superficial and we have absolutely nothing in common.
words.scene: 瑞秋承认自己喜欢保罗只是表面上的吸引，两人连语言都不通。
words.example: Their friendship was based on superficial similarities.
words.originalZh: 我知道这完全是肤浅的，我们完全没有任何共同点。
words.exampleZh: 他们的友谊建立在表面上的相似之处。

expressions.original: The entire city is blacked out!
expressions.scene: 全城突然大停电，大家在公寓里望向窗外。
expressions.example: The neighborhood blacked out during the thunderstorm.
expressions.originalZh: 整个城市都漆黑了！
expressions.exampleZh: 雷暴期间，附近地区停电了。

expressions.original: I'm trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre!
expressions.scene: 钱德勒兴奋又紧张地告诉朋友他和名模被困在ATM厅。
expressions.example: We were trapped in the elevator for twenty minutes.
expressions.originalZh: 我和吉尔·古达克被困在 ATM 机前厅里！
expressions.exampleZh: 我们被困在电梯里二十分钟。

expressions.original: Jill says vestibule... I'm going with vestibule.
expressions.scene: 吉尔说那个地方叫vestibule，钱德勒决定就用这个词。
expressions.example: I'll go with the blue shirt—it matches your eyes.
expressions.originalZh: 吉尔说前庭……我要选择前庭。
expressions.exampleZh: 我会穿蓝色衬衫——它很配你的眼睛。

expressions.original: You'd better act surprised.
expressions.scene: 乔伊泄露了罗斯要给莫妮卡办惊喜派对，让莫妮卡假装惊讶。
expressions.example: I already know about the gift, but I'll act surprised.
expressions.originalZh: 你最好表现得很惊讶。
expressions.exampleZh: 我已经知道这份礼物了，但我会表现得很惊讶。

expressions.original: I'm always the last one to know everything.
expressions.scene: 菲比抱怨自己总是最后一个知道朋友们的秘密。
expressions.example: I was the last one to know about their engagement.
expressions.originalZh: 我总是最后一个知道一切的人。
expressions.exampleZh: 我是最后一个知道他们订婚的人。

expressions.original: I was the last one to know when you had a crush on Joey when he was moving in.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋说出莫妮卡曾经暗恋乔伊的秘密。
expressions.example: She had a crush on him since freshman year.
expressions.originalZh: 当乔伊搬进来时，我是最后一个知道你迷恋他的人。
expressions.exampleZh: 她从大一就喜欢上了他。

expressions.meaning: 朋友区（只能做朋友，无法发展成恋人）
expressions.original: Because you waited too long to make your move, and now you're in the friend zone.
expressions.scene: 乔伊告诉罗斯，因为他迟迟没有行动，已经被瑞秋当成朋友了。
expressions.example: He's been in the friend zone for years and can't escape.
expressions.originalZh: 因为你等了太久才采取行动，现在你已经进入了朋友区。
expressions.exampleZh: 他在朋友圈里呆了很多年，无法逃脱。

expressions.original: Because you waited too long to make your move, and now you're in the friend zone.
expressions.scene: 乔伊批评罗斯没有主动追求瑞秋。
expressions.example: If you like her, you should make a move before someone else does.
expressions.originalZh: 因为你等了太久才采取行动，现在你已经进入了朋友区。
expressions.exampleZh: 如果你喜欢她，你就应该比别人先行动。

expressions.original: What's messing you up? The wine? The candles? The moonlight?
expressions.scene: 乔伊问罗斯在这么好的气氛下还在犹豫什么。
expressions.example: Don't mess up this opportunity—it's important.
expressions.originalZh: 你有什么烦恼吗？酒？蜡烛？月光？
expressions.exampleZh: 不要错过这个机会——这很重要。

expressions.meaning: 心里记下，暗自提醒自己
expressions.original: Mental note: If Jill Goodacre offers you gum, you take it.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒后悔拒绝了吉尔的口香糖，在心里提醒自己下次一定要接受。
expressions.example: Mental note: never leave the house without an umbrella.
expressions.originalZh: 请记住：如果吉尔·古达克给你口香糖，你就接受它。
expressions.exampleZh: 谨记：切勿在没有雨伞的情况下离开家。

S01E08.title: The One Where Nana Dies Twice

words.original: Hey gorgeous , how's it going?
words.scene: 钱德勒在咖啡馆遇到同事雪莉，对方打招呼
words.example: You look gorgeous in that dress.
words.originalZh: 嘿，美丽，怎么样？
words.exampleZh: 你穿那件衣服看起来很漂亮。

words.original: I mean, is that ridiculous?
words.scene: 钱德勒对雪莉误会自己是同性恋感到荒谬
words.example: That's a ridiculous idea.
words.originalZh: 我的意思是，这很荒谬吗？
words.exampleZh: 这是一个荒谬的想法。

words.original: Do you want a date Saturday?
words.scene: 雪莉想给钱德勒介绍约会对象
words.example: I'm going on a date tonight.
words.originalZh: 星期六你想约会吗？
words.exampleZh: 今晚我要去约会。

words.original: I met somebody who would be perfect for you.
words.scene: 雪莉说对方和钱德勒很配
words.example: This job is perfect for me.
words.originalZh: 我遇到了一个最适合你的人。
words.exampleZh: 这份工作非常适合我。

words.original: Well, this is fascinating.
words.scene: 钱德勒听说大家曾以为他是同性恋
words.example: The lecture was absolutely fascinating.
words.originalZh: 嗯，这很有趣。
words.exampleZh: 讲座绝对令人着迷。

words.original: I was worried you guys were gonna be vague about this.
words.scene: 钱德勒讽刺大家只说他有“气质”
words.example: Her answer was vague and confusing.
words.originalZh: 我担心你们对此会含糊其辞。
words.exampleZh: 她的回答含糊不清且令人困惑。

words.original: You just have a quality.
words.scene: 大家解释为什么觉得钱德勒像同性恋
words.example: She has a quality that makes people trust her.
words.originalZh: 你只是有一种品质。
words.exampleZh: 她有一种让人们信任她的品质。

words.original: Women find you less threatening, they let their guards down...
words.scene: 菲比分析为什么女人会对钱德勒卸下防备
words.example: The big dog looked threatening.
words.originalZh: 女人发现你不再那么具有威胁性，她们就会放松警惕......
words.exampleZh: 那只大狗看起来很威胁。

words.original: Believe me, apparently other people have made the same mistake.
words.scene: 钱德勒得知 Lowell 也曾误会
words.example: Apparently, she's moving to Paris.
words.originalZh: 相信我，显然其他人也犯过同样的错误。

words.originalZh: 那太残酷了。
words.exampleZh: 嘲笑别人是很残忍的事。

words.original: Why don't you just get a roommate?

words.originalZh: 你为什么不找个室友呢？
words.exampleZh: 我和我的室友共用厨房。

words.original: I'll be just as pathetic as you.
words.scene: 瑞秋说自己没有保罗陪也很惨

words.originalZh: 我也会像你一样可怜。

words.original: He's not even jolly.

words.originalZh: 他甚至都不快乐。
words.exampleZh: 圣诞老人经常被描述为快乐的。

words.original: I'm gonna be one of his helpers.

words.originalZh: 我要成为他的助手之一。
words.exampleZh: 她是一名老师的助手。

words.original: I say this year, no dates, we make a pact.
words.scene: 罗斯提议新年不约会约定

words.originalZh: 我说今年，没有约会，我们达成协议。
words.exampleZh: 我们约定每天坚持锻炼。

words.original: I was hoping for a little more enthusiasm.
words.scene: 罗斯希望大家对约定更热情

words.originalZh: 我希望能有更多的热情。

words.example: The product is in high demand.

words.original: I think it's romantic.

words.scene: 菲比形容大卫

words.originalZh: ……他更聪明、更温柔、更可爱……
words.exampleZh: 对宝宝要温柔。

words.original: David's, like, a scientist guy.

words.originalZh: 大卫就像一个科学家。

words.scene: 大卫在咖啡店讲物理理论

words.originalZh: 但是，你无法实际测试这个理论。
words.exampleZh: 爱因斯坦发展了相对论。

words.originalZh: 这绝对是一个有效的问题。
words.exampleZh: 您的护照有效期为十年。

words.scene: 大卫解释想等完美时刻再吻
words.example: The concert was phenomenal.
words.originalZh: 我希望这是在这个非凡时刻发生的非凡之吻......
words.exampleZh: 音乐会非常精彩。

words.original: Look at me, spilling everywhere.
words.scene: 莫妮卡在聚会上洒了饮料
words.example: Don't spill juice on the carpet.
words.originalZh: 看看我，洒得到处都是。
words.exampleZh: 不要将果汁洒在地毯上。

words.scene: 莫妮卡帮瑞秋涂口红
words.example: She applied red lipstick.
words.originalZh: 你涂口红的范围有点大了。
words.exampleZh: 她涂了红色口红。

words.original: He was more embarrassed about that than anyone.
words.scene: 罗斯为 Marcel 尿在桌上道歉

words.originalZh: 对此，他比任何人都感到羞耻。
words.exampleZh: 我为自己的错误感到尴尬。

words.original: And for him to have the courage to walk back in here like nothing happened...
words.scene: 罗斯为 Marcel 辩护
words.example: It takes courage to speak in public.
words.originalZh: 而他竟然有勇气像什么都没发生过一样走回这里……

words.originalZh: 你和我有什么交集吗？
words.exampleZh: 在聚会上，我喜欢与新朋友交往。

words.original: And then your face exploded?
words.scene: 钱德勒调侃瑞秋受伤的脸

words.exampleZh: 气球随着一声巨响爆炸了。

words.original: I'm still in there, changing his diapers.
words.scene: 罗斯抱怨照顾 Marcel

words.originalZh: 我还在里面给他换尿布。
words.exampleZh: 宝宝需要干净的尿布。

words.original: Picking his fleas.
words.scene: 罗斯继续抱怨照顾 Marcel

words.originalZh: 给他摘跳蚤。
words.exampleZh: 这只狗接受了跳蚤治疗。

words.scene: 瑞秋被抢出租车的女人扑倒

words.exampleZh: 这位足球运动员完成了一次精彩的铲球。

words.original: And I hit my head on the curb...
words.scene: 瑞秋摔倒撞到路边
words.example: He parked too close to the curb.
words.originalZh: 然后我的头撞到了路边...
words.exampleZh: 他把车停得太靠近路边了。

words.original: So I'm blowing my attack whistle thingy...

words.originalZh: 所以我吹响了进攻哨子……
words.exampleZh: 裁判吹响了哨子。

words.original: Screw Paolo, screw the psycho cab lady.
words.scene: 瑞秋骂抢出租车的女人

words.originalZh: 去他的保罗，去他那个神经质的出租车女士。
words.exampleZh: 那个神经病司机差点撞到我。

words.original: ...sweep everything off the table...
words.scene: 大卫说想浪漫地把桌上东西扫掉

words.originalZh: ...把桌子上的所有东西都扫掉...
words.exampleZh: 她把地板扫干净了。

expressions.original: Well, for your information, Paolo is gonna be in Rome this New Year...
expressions.scene: 瑞秋告诉钱德勒保罗新年不在

expressions.scene: 钱德勒抱怨新年压力

expressions.originalZh: 我厌倦了成为迪克·克拉克假期的受害者。

expressions.meaning: 一记耳光；令人难堪的待遇

expressions.originalZh: 这简直就是一巴掌打在脸上，你知道吗？

expressions.original: Ladies and gentlemen, back by popular demand, Miss Phoebe Buffay.

expressions.exampleZh: 乐队应大众要求回归。

expressions.original: Could you speak up please?

expressions.originalZh: 只要让他离我远点就行了。
expressions.exampleZh: 远离悬崖边缘。
